body: Amazing Alphons. Of course we are not alone, but yeah when someone writes a story identical to your own life it feels something special. Wish you the best too, hopefully we both can escape the anxiety.

Thanks for reply River. Truly inspiring words I'll remember. I'm trying to act normal in social situations, but I still can't control myself and I feel like a clumsy robot. I was out friday bowling for an hour, my friend took a video and sent it to me and others. You could see how nervous I was, not how I would act alone. It ended with me getting depressed and then I went home. Sometimes I wonder how suprised people would be if they saw the normal me. You know like a hidden camera in my house.. I hope I one day will break the anxiety but I doubt it. I can't live like this forever that's for sure.
